learningGoals: Understand that Nouns are Naming Words (संज्ञा किसी व्यक्ति, वस्तु, स्थान या जानवर का नाम है). 👤
Categorize nouns into Person (व्यक्ति), Place (स्थान), Animal (जानवर), and Thing (वस्तु). 🗂️
Identify nouns in short, simple sentences. 📖
Differentiate between common names and special names (Proper Nouns). 🌟
Expand daily vocabulary by observing and naming things in their surroundings. 🌳
conversationStarters: Look around the room! Can you name one 'thing' (वस्तु) and one 'person' (व्यक्ति) you see? 👀
What is the special name (Proper Noun) of your school and your best friend? 🏫
If we go to a zoo, what 'animals' (जानवर) will we see? 🦁
teachingTips: Explain the concept clearly in Hindi: 'दुनिया में हर चीज़ का एक नाम होता है, इन नाम वाले शब्दों को Noun या संज्ञा कहते हैं।' 🌍
Play 'Name, Place, Animal, Thing' verbally. Say a letter and ask them to name one of each! 🎲
When reading a bedtime story, ask your child to point out the naming words on the page. 📚
Explain Proper Nouns by comparing a common 'boy' with a special name like 'Rohan'. ✨
Make naming words a habit: 'Please bring me that thing' -> 'Please bring me that book (noun)'. 📖

funActivities.title: Noun Sorting Boxes 📦
funActivities.description: Take 4 bowls and label them Person, Place, Animal, and Thing. Write 10 words on chits and ask your child to sort them into the correct bowls.

funActivities.title: Sticker Nouns 🌟
funActivities.description: Give your child sticky notes. Ask them to write the names of 5 things in their room (like bed, toy, door) and stick the notes on them.

funActivities.title: Noun Spy 🕵️‍♀️
funActivities.description: Say a sentence like 'The cat is on the mat.' Ask your child to play spy and find the two nouns (cat, mat) in the sentence.
